name: Bikini
description:
A micro bikini is less a garment and more a point of view, and this collection commits to it completely. These are minimal-coverage lingerie sets built for the bedroom rather than the beach: strappy triangle tops, barely-there bottoms, and details that do the heavy lifting. The range leans into cosplay, with plush animal prints, maid and bunny variations, cow prints, and holiday-themed sets alongside clean lace versions in classic black, white, and red. Every set packs maximum impact into minimal fabric, with stretch straps and adjustable ties that let you dial the reveal up or down.

How to Choose a Micro Bikini Set

Coverage is the first decision: classic micro cuts show skin and confidence in equal measure, while sets with chains and extras add structure for costume nights and photos. Fabric comes next—stretch straps forgive and flatter, sheer mesh plays with what it hides, and plush or velour textures turn an outfit into a character. Color does the rest: black reads bold and classic, white keeps things innocent, and red or pink push the mood toward romance. To complete a full character look, pair your set with matching pieces from our cosplay collection.

name: Fishnet lingerie
description:
Fishnet stockings are the fastest way to take an outfit from simple to statement, and this collection stretches the classic far beyond basic black. Choose thigh high fishnet stockings to wear with garter belts, skirts, and lingerie sets, or go head to toe with fishnet dresses and bodystockings. Color sets the tone: black fishnet stays cool and versatile for everyday wear, while a true red turns the heat up for date nights. The open weave flatters every body type, with plenty of forgiving stretch that hugs your shape instead of squeezing it.

How to Style Fishnet Stockings

Start with the net itself: classic fishnet is the everyday go-to, fine micro-net reads subtle under tailored pants, and larger fence-net weaves make the boldest impact. Finer weaves read closer to a sheer tight; wider diamonds stretch further and read bolder. Layering is where fishnet shines: wear thigh high fishnet stockings over opaque tights for winter texture, or pair them with shorts for lived-in rock edge. To keep the open weave snag-free, hand wash in cool water and dry flat. For a softer counterpoint, contrast your fishnet with delicate lace from our stockings collection.

name: Nightwear
description:
Shop sexy nightwear designed for real nights in: soft against skin, easy to move in, and cut to flatter. As our largest lingerie collection, this range moves from satin and silk-feel slips to babydoll silhouettes and relaxed full-length gowns, with each style built for a different mood. Think of a sexy nightwear dress as your go-to when you want effortlessness: one piece, instant polish, nothing to coordinate. Fabrics lean toward smooth satin, breathable cotton blends, and playful sheer mesh, so you can choose exactly how much coverage feels right for the evening ahead.

How to Choose Your Sexy Nightwear

Match the fabric to the moment first: satin and silk-feel slips read dressed-up and photograph beautifully, breathable cotton-blend pieces are the ones you will actually sleep in, and lace or mesh panels add sheerness without a full reveal. Next, pick your length: short, swingy cuts float away from the body and suit every figure, while long gowns skim the line for a sleeker finish. For romantic evenings, layer your pick with thigh highs from our stockings collection, and keep a soft robe by the bed for the morning after.

name: Stockings
description:
Shop lace stockings designed to stay up, feel soft, and complete any lingerie look. This collection covers the styles you will reach for again and again: delicate lace top bands, sheer nylon legs, and statement open-weave designs, each cut to follow the leg from toe to thigh with gentle stretch that flatters without pinching. Whether you are dressing for a romantic evening or adding an elegant finish to a costume, a well-made pair of thigh high stockings keeps its fit from morning to midnight. Add a garter belt for a secure hold and a silhouette that never goes out of style.

How to Find Your Perfect Lace Stockings

Think color first: classic black carries the most styling range, while red and pastel shades set a bolder mood. Next, consider the fabric: stretch lace adds romantic texture, sheer nylon reads soft and natural, and fishnet brings instant edge. Finally, check sizing against your thigh measurement (or the height-and-weight chart) rather than shoe size, since the band sits on the thigh. A well-sized pair stays in place without digging in, while silicone bands or a matching garter belt add extra security for sheer fabrics. For bolder net looks, browse our fishnet lingerie collection.
